raw_inputs.name: ie_data(1).xls
raw_inputs.description: Robert J. Shiller U.S. stock market data, sheet Data

raw_hashes_note: ie_data.xls is not redistributed in this repository; its SHA-256 is declared by the data handoff. The final CSV is verified by work/tools/verify_canonical_data.py.

stock_signal.use: spx_close = canonical stock signal price at date; spx_close_prev = canonical stock signal price at the previous Friday

construction.units: trailing_dps_points = Shiller_D * SPX rebase factor 23.2423477355492638731596828992 (unit change only; the yield is scale invariant)
construction.annual_yield_pct: Shiller_D / Shiller_P * 100 for the month of date (computed from the Shiller fields, not from the rebased price)
construction.trailing_dps_points: monthly trailing D (month of date) in the rebased SPX units
construction.dividend_points: trailing_dps_points / number of Fridays in the calendar year of date (52 or 53)
construction.economic_definition: equals the DIV-009 fallback spread_annual_dps; the runtime keeps tax.dividend_approx_method=use_supplied_dividend_return
construction.status: actual for 1970-01-02..2025-12-26; estimate for every 2026 row (quality of the annual/trailing dividend, not a cash payment date)

estimate_2026.q3_2026_estimate_source: data handoff forecast (index points); not a Shiller actual
estimate_2026.method: TTM Sep 2026 = TTM Jun 2026 - Q3 2025 actual + Q3 2026 estimate = 81.7032 - 19.81 + 21.13 = 83.0232; Jul and Aug linear interpolation

summary.estimate_2026: Q3 2026 estimate = 21.13 index points; TTM Sep 2026 = TTM Jun 2026 (81.7032) - Q3 2025 actual (19.81) + Q3 2026 estimate (21.13) = 83.0232; Jul/Aug linear interpolation
summary.smoothing: dividend_points = trailing_dps_points / Fridays in calendar year; dividend_return = dividend_points / spx_close_prev
